description: Track A stage 2 capability manifest (client and server entries). The renderer's own computations are compiled with `sync: true`; its async capabilities are the re-exported async components and the streaming / async server renderers.
featureExportsDescription: Core runtime slicing (documentation/plans/core-runtime-slicing.md): per link-time feature switch of @solidjs/signals (src/core/features.ts), the exports whose use needs it. The capability linker turns a switch off for a fully known graph that imports none of them (a namespace import uses them all). COMPILED_SEAMS is decided by the compiler configuration, never by imports.
